name: Rise
quote: In search of footprints leading to the abyss.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor... As always, I will give it my all at work today.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Please don't worry. It's quite usual for people in my profession to find meat revolting.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Do you like sci-fi movies? Especially the ones rated R... such as Xenomorphs and Spaceship Troopers?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Working till midnight is quite a usual occurrence to me, though it really sucks...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Every creature has their own will. Every creature has their own purpose... Sorry, I started muttering to myself again.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: With modern technology, no one can completely erase their tracks... That's right, no one can do that.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Gone...? Then where can I find the Professor?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Is there anything you need? I want to go back to the dorm and get some proper rest... Work was both terrible and tiring last night.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Uh...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: You seem rather free right now.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Buck up and get to work.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I am Rise. I'll skip the lengthy self-intro. You'll get to know me in time.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I feel stronger... There is no limit to my potential.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Follow elusive traces that most people wouldn't even notice and exploit every single weakness or loophole. That's the only way to the truth.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I'll work hard to get used to this place and do my very best, so just leave it all to me.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Let's get to work.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Time to go.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Pay no heed to those who are about to die.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: It's all over.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Mission completed without a hitch.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Hm...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Are you really not afraid of me? After all...
Still, you seem to have made up your mind. In that case, I'll give you my answer... I'm overjoyed.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: It's the new year, huh... Then can I get some special reward from you, Professor? Just a card is good enough.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: A small, insignificant gift—chocolate in a tin, absolutely nothing special... Please accept it, Professor. That would make me very happy.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Tanabata? The festival from the east? Well, it is said that your wish come true if it is written on a piece of paper and hung up on a leaf. Now, let me try my hand at this.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Compared to the things I see every single day, the ghosts and monsters on Halloween are a joke... Hold on, can I have two more slices of pumpkin pie? I'm a bit hungry.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. You know... I can't really stomach eating meat, right? That's why I have replaced the Christmas dinner menu to ones with veggies and desserts. However, if that's not to your liking, I can prepare some extra meat for you.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: It's your birthday, Professor, you need to buck up. Speaking of which, the new Xenomorphs movie is coming out today, can you come and watch it with me?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Uh... I look like a complete mess, don't I?
These red stains on my clothes? It's just spilled paint...
It'll be fine once I clean them off. Don't worry.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
I simply don't like eating meat... I came out of the factory this way.
Maybe my programmer was a vegetarian and he programmed his habits into me?
That really is the only reason. Please don't get the wrong idea, or I'll be offended.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Are you interested in sci-fi films, Professor?
I prefer those that are rated R. You know, the kind that's gory all over the screen, because of my job...
No, I've just always liked this sort of cheap stimulation. I know I'm weird...

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Here for another chat...?
Huh? How did you find out? Don't tell me that maid...
Never mind, I'll admit it... I'm a medical examiner working in forensic science. I deal with stuff that most people can't stomach on a daily basis.
I generally don't bring it up so as not to scare anyone.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
My real dream...?
What if I tell you I want to be in the movie industry? Going from a movie buff to a production crew member... I would have to start from scratch.
After all, you always have to pick up new skills when you switch professions.
What about you? Have you considered another career before? It's okay, you can tell me.

career:
After World War 3, in order to stabilize and restore regional order, the government urgently needed the police to take over for the military and resume the responsibility of maintaining law and order. Despite this, the violent crime rate remained high. Ultimate Life Holdings recognized this as a business opportunity and so, the Forensic 3.6 Doll came into being.

As part of the first batch of Forensic 3.6 forensic investigator Dolls, Rise acted as an outside consultant to a police station in the Netherlands. After Project Neural Cloud started, she was recommended by her employer and selected as a tester for her impressive talents.
infoStories:
In the early days of the technology's development, no police department would purchase a forensic Doll in an official capacity. Rise's employer is a police officer in the emergency department of the Amsterdam police force. He had felt helpless in the face of the endlessly growing number of unsolved cases, but after she arrived, she helped them greatly increase their work efficiency.

As a forensic Doll, Rise has a higher tolerance for the results of terrible crimes than the vast majority of humans. She can also pick up details that are difficult for humans to detect. Through the use of customized sensors and analysis modules, she can even perform a partial reconstruction of the crime through lingering pheromones. Once the job is over, she takes the responsibility for cleaning the site, ensuring that the poor soul who rents the place next doesn't notice that a crime took place there.

However, Rise will not utter a single word in the process of carrying out her tests, making it difficult to grasp what she is thinking. The way that she silently makes her way around the bloodstained scene is enough to unnerve the rookies.

"Idiot! Go outside if you need to throw up! She's far more capable than you!"
—Crime Scene Investigation Recording

Rise doesn't have any particular feelings about her status as a contractor. No matter what her title is, the particulars of her work won't change much.

Her attitude to her work is similarly ambiguous. She doesn't particularly like it, but she also doesn't really hate it—she was just loyal to her employer, dutifully completing the tasks given to her and trusting they would have significance.

Sometimes, after a case is solved, Rise will be thanked by the deceased's family. During World War 3, many humans lost their lives, their bodies spread all over the land reduced to an abstract statistic. Now, in a society that is steadily restoring order, they are upholding the final dignity of the dead through their investigations. The gratitude from those families convinced Rise of the value of her work.

"It's not out of preference... just... this is meaningful work, so someone has to do it, right?"

Rise has a secret interest—she's a fan of sci-fi movies, especially the particularly gory ones. Mysterious aliens suddenly appear and attack humanity, bringing ruin and disaster... for her, these kinds of intense scenes actually relax her body and mind.

She isn't sure why she has such a hobby. Is it a preference set for her professional needs? Or is it something that she steadily gained an interest in over the course of her work? She doesn't have an answer to that and has long since put it out of her mind. Perhaps it's because these types of films allow her to enjoy those "special" scenes outside of work, which gives her a liberating feeling.

Rise does not take the initiative to discuss personal matters, including her career and hobbies with others. This isn't because she has something against those topics, but because she doesn't want those around her to feel uneasy. No matter what, those who have recently experienced war yearn for a relatively peaceful life. She doesn't want others to be tainted by the ominous scent of blood due to her.

That said, if you become a close friend of Rise, then she will let her guard down to a degree. Once, Rise chatted with her employer about her sci-fi movie habit and even accidentally leaked her dream: she would like to one day be able to break into the film industry that she loves so much. She wants to work with people who have the same passion as her and produce the ideal sci-fi movie.

"The speaker speaks carelessly, but the listener listens carefully." After that conversation, Rise's employer began to secretly search for her replacement. Rise wouldn't be able to realize her cinema dreams while she was forever trapped in the cold police station. After all, it was due to Rise's efforts that the local crime rate had fallen, so this was a way to give back a little. However, before Rise's long vacation, she still had one final task—participate in Project Neural Cloud and save her precious work data.

As a result, Rise has yet to achieve her freedom, but she doesn't hate life in the Oasis. In her spare time, she has the opportunity to connect with people and things that she wasn't able to in the past. She also has enough time to get to know them in a way she is comfortable with...

"Lately, I've been feeling a cold gaze watching me, especially when I'm sneakily watching movies... Hey, could it be because the script's deadline is fast approaching?"
—Doll Psychological Evaluation Recording
oathDesc: Let's become the main characters of each other's lives.

"That's enough information for me to work on. Leave the rest to me. Criminals must pay for their transgressions."

projections.name: Spokesperson of the Dead
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The dead deserve justice. It is their last chance to exercise the rights they were born with as a human."

skinList.name: Holidays Tomorrow!
skinList.desc:
[Call of Study Series]
Leaving the clumsy classmates she met during her anatomy classes behind to attend the photography summer camp she loves—it's what Rise has been looking forward to all semester.

skinList.name: Unnatural Awakening
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection— "It isn't the designated time yet. Why was I awakened early? There are signs of damage to the machinery... Good, it seems this will be the first crime scene I'll be handling."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Professor, I hope you'll spend the rest of our time together looking for a good camera angle with me..."
